title: Wanderlane Traveller Club Earning Rate Card
content:
The rates on this card are the earning rates of the Wanderlane Traveller Club. The earn rate is the number of spendable points earned for each US dollar of qualifying spend. The tier bonus is the percentage bonus added to base accruals for holding the tier. Partner earning records whether activity with earning partners outside the platform accrues points at all, and the partner rate is the percentage of the platform earn rate applied to that partner activity.

## The rate card

| Basis | Blue | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Titanium | Ambassador |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Earn rate (points to the US dollar) | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 8 |
| Tier bonus (per cent) | 0 | 10 | 25 | 50 | 75 | 100 |
| Partner earning permitted | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Partner rate (per cent of the platform rate) | 0 | 50 | 75 | 100 | 100 | 125 |

## Points of judgement on the card

At Wanderlane Blue the tier bonus stands at 0 per cent, partner earning is not permitted, and the partner rate stands at 0 per cent. Partner earning is permitted at Wanderlane Silver and above.

The partner rate is read against the platform earn rate of the same tier, not against any figure of its own: at Wanderlane Silver the partner rate is 50 per cent, at Wanderlane Gold 75 per cent, at Wanderlane Platinum and Wanderlane Titanium 100 per cent, and at Wanderlane Ambassador 125 per cent, which is the one tier at which the partner percentage stands above 100 per cent.
